summary_1line: Despairing monkeys vow to starve until the vulture Sampati appears, moved by mention of his brother Jatayu and asking to hear of his death.

image_candidates.scene_text: On the seashore, rows of grieving monkeys sit on darbha grass facing south, tears falling as they vow to fast unto death.
From a cave high on the Vindhya mountain, the aged vulture Sampati peers down at the gathered monkeys, thinking them prey.
Wing-scorched Sampati stands on a rocky ledge crying out in shock at hearing his brother Jatayu's name spoken by the monkeys below.
